title: SQL Injection in VulnerableAppointmentRepository.findByBarberId
description: The findByBarberId method uses string interpolation to directly embed the barberId parameter into the SQL query string. An attacker can inject SQL by providing a malicious barberId like '1' OR '1'='1' -- to retrieve appointments for all barbers.
impact: Cross-barber appointment data exfiltration. An attacker can access appointments belonging to any barber by injecting SQL in the barberId parameter.
mitigation: Replace string interpolation with parameterized queries using $1 placeholder. Use the executor.query method with parameters array as shown in secure implementations.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for SQL injection in findByBarberId method

Determined status as VALID because Confirmed SQL injection in findByBarberId method at line 40: direct string interpolation of user-supplied 'barberId' parameter into SQL query. Same pattern as findByCustomerId - vulnerable to injection.
